|

|   |-- load -> resolved model + SessionHistory -> initial/active messages
|   `-- request -> shared SessionModelRequest (not privately owned)
|-- SessionModelRequest
|   |-- primary: plugin-shaped request + executeTool callback
|   `-- -> host SessionModelTransport.bind for session WebSocket options
|-- SessionCompaction
|   `-- estimate / compact / precompute: automatic, explicit and overflow paths
`-- SessionRunnerLLM (implements SessionRunner.Service)
    |-- titles: FiberMap keyed by sessionID; background title generation
    |-- drain / runStep closures: boundary and logical-step policy
    |   `-- -> shared context, compaction, inbox and request services
    `-- SessionStep helper (constructed once by this runner's layer)
        |-- Captures Bus / LLMClient / Snapshot / ToolOutput dependencies
        `-- attempt(): fresh scoped publisher, stream and tool-run records
